feeds.title: Meanwhile, back at the ranch…
feeds.description: I am Jessie. A singer, writer, photographer, art advocate, and a mom living on a ranch in the middle of North Dakota's Wild West! Read the poetry and the stories, listen to the music, look at the pictures, get inspired, give us ideas and come see it for yourself someday.

feeds.title: Sifa's Corner
feeds.description: I am Wasifa, the blogger behind 'Sifa's Corner', beauty and healthy lifestyle blog. I have taken courses in skin care & esthetics and have worked as freelance Makeup Artist. Sifa's Corner covers serious health concerns, tutorials of everyday/glam makeup looks, product reviews, DIY tips, Beauty Hauls, and such.
